summary: A Dark Room is a minimalist text-based adventure game that runs entirely within your web browser. It presents a stripped-down interface focusing on narrative progression and resource management without heavy graphics.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you enjoy retro text adventures or want a lightweight, distraction-free browser game to host locally.
watchOut: The project sees very little active maintenance, meaning you are unlikely to receive updates or bug fixes.
deployNotes: As a static Javascript application, it typically only requires a basic web server to serve the assets and generally does not need a dedicated database or persistent backend storage.
